title: Lemon-Caper Chicken Piccata with Whole-Wheat Spaghetti & Roasted Broccolini
summary: Tender pan-seared chicken cutlets in a bright lemon-caper broth sauce (no butter or dairy), served with whole-wheat spaghetti and roasted broccolini. 35–40 minutes total, 25–30 minutes active.
ingredients: 1 3/4 lb kosher boneless skinless chicken breasts, sliced horizontally into thin cutlets
1/3 cup all-purpose flour for a light dusting
3 tbsp olive oil, divided, plus a little extra if needed
1 large lemon (2–3 tbsp juice plus optional zest)
1 1/2 tbsp capers, drained and rinsed (optional for children)
12 oz whole-wheat spaghetti or linguine, kosher-certified pareve
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss broccolini with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet and roast 12–15 minutes, turning once; broccoli florets may need 18–20 minutes.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook whole-wheat spaghetti according to package directions; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.

Pat chicken dry, pound or slice to roughly 1/2-inch thickness, season lightly, and dust with flour. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook in batches about 3–4 minutes per side, until golden and chicken reaches 165°F internally. Transfer to a plate.

Reduce heat to medium. Add garlic to the skillet and stir for 20–30 seconds. Pour in broth and scrape browned bits from pan. Add lemon juice and capers, simmer 2–3 minutes to reduce slightly. Return chicken and any juices to pan for 1 minute to coat. Add parsley if using.

Serve chicken with spaghetti and roasted broccolini; spoon lemon broth sauce over chicken and pasta. If desired, loosen pasta with reserved water and a drizzle of olive oil. No Parmesan, butter, or cream.
child_friendly_modifications: Set aside a couple of chicken cutlets before adding capers and lemon sauce. Slice into strips and serve with plain spaghetti and soft roasted broccolini florets; offer a small cup of lemon sauce to try as a dip. Cut spaghetti shorter and chicken into bite-size pieces for the 3-year-old.
leftovers: Refrigerate chicken, pasta and broccolini within 2 hours, ideally in separate containers. Eat within 3–4 days. Reheat chicken gently with a splash of broth until 165°F, and serve in a pareve pita or over reheated pasta with leftover vegetables.
